title: [observability] The open-alerts banner on every page says how long a mission has been without work as of now, as Home does
prompt:
Read web/src/components/alerts/AlertsView.tsx (`OpenAlerts`, the red banner at the top of every page; `AlertRow`, each row of the Alerts page) and web/src/home.ts (`alertWords`, objective 071).

The problem, as the owner reads the live pages (lead-mac, sync/queue.md 1503 and 1631; sync/home-2026-11-12-1044.png). 071 is verified on Home: Needs you reads "mission #6 has had no task in work for 31 h", matching the Missions card. The red banner at the top of the other pages (Show, at 10:44) still reads "mission #6 has had no task in work for 21 h 25 min", the words of the moment the alert fired, beside a "since 5h ago" that moves. `OpenAlerts` prints the newest open alert's stored `text`, and so does each row of the Alerts page. Only Home goes through `alertWords(alert, now)`. The same alert reads two different durations on two pages, and the banner is the one that is wrong.

Required behaviour.
(a) web/src/home.ts exports `openAlertsLine(alerts, now)`: null for no alert; else {count, text, fired_at_ms}: how many alerts there are, the newest one's (by fired_at_ms) words as of `now` (`alertWords`), and when it fired.
(b) A `mission_idle` alert's words count on, as on Home ("31 h", then "3 d"). An alert of any other kind keeps its own text.
(c) `OpenAlerts` renders from `openAlertsLine`, and each Alerts page row says `alertWords(alert, now)`. Both keep their layout.
(d) home.ts keeps loading with node alone.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/080.sh. The history is seeded as the store holds it (071's way): mission 1 takes its work from a backlog, its one task was cancelled 31 h ago, and its `mission_idle` alert is written as the alert step writes it, 15 min after. `spawn serve` answers. Under node over `GET /api/alerts`:
- (1) openAlertsLine at 31 h after the task ended is {count 1, the "31 h" words, the alert's fired_at_ms}, and [] gives null;
- (2) at 72 h it reads "3 d"; a newer alert of another kind beside it gives count 2 and that alert's own text; an older one gives count 2 and the mission's "31 h" words.
It fails with 1 on be660edd: home.ts has no openAlertsLine. No check reads the page's source, so (c), the banner and the Alerts page rendering these words, is checked by lead-mac's screenshot of the banner on a page other than Home while a mission_idle alert is open.

The product reason. The banner is on every page, so it's what the owner sees most. A duration frozen at the moment the alert fired understates the problem more each hour it stays open, and it contradicts Home and the Missions card.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (071 among them) and add web/test tests of your own for openAlertsLine: none, one mission_idle alert as of two times, and two alerts of different kinds in either order.
